policy: Source-base parameter arguments are required unless zero-input execution is separately proven; optional individual fields do not imply omission is safe. Explicit frontend semantic-contract follow-ups. Names, finite keys, enforced required groups, and supported output categories come from parsed source, inheritance, reachable execution/helper reads, and wire serialization. Base broad values are permissive; backend validation remains authoritative. Audited overrides live in verified-contracts.ts; per-class evidence and proof rules live in source-contracts.json. Output-only refinements and their helper/serializer evidence are maintained separately in *-output-types.ts and *-output-evidence.json. Runtime-dependent payloads are not unresolved output contracts.

reasons.unverified-values-and-requiredness: Trace input consumers for value types, multiplicity, requiredness, and defaults beyond inventoried named keys; incomplete MCP metadata is not authoritative.
reasons.unverified-values-and-additional-validat: The reachable organizeKeys/checkOptional path proves the recorded required groups. Value types, multiplicity, defaults, and additional execution validation still need semantic audit.
reasons.unverified-wire-shape: Trace opaque/polymorphic execute producers and special PixelStreamUtility/Gson serialization before replacing unknown.
reasons.unverified-nested-output: The source proves a map/list outer shape, but concrete nested fields/elements remain unverified and deliberately unknown.
